lenses.label: Hubble · optical lines
lenses.title: Crab ejecta in optical emission lines
lenses.description: Published SITELLE ejecta and a conditional expansion-depth model share a frame with separate pulsar-wind components. RGB, opacity and component strengths are authored display choices; this is not measured gas or dust density. The historical material repeats image color through depth and remains a known visual limitation. The reference preview shows the published photograph before star removal and 3D material fitting. Surrounding optical stars use Gaia positions and parallax-informed distances; their brightness/color display is independent of this spectral image.
lenses.summary: Optical line colors on expansion-inferred ejecta and a modeled pulsar wind; fine structure is softened.

facts.label: Bands
facts.value: Optical · [O III] 502 nm / [O I] 631 nm / [S II] 673 nm
